name: licoes
description: Claude Code's general lessons, by subscription: Claude looks up the lesson that fits each moment. The plugin also warns about secrets in a commit and about stale chats, passes the baton between chats, checks the screen learns from your corrections and, if you turn it on, from your chats.

chave.title: License key
chave.description: The key from your purchase email (starts with lg_). Without it only the lessons are off; the rest of the plugin works.

destilar.title: Learn on its own from your chats
destilar.description: At the end of each chat, it keeps what cost you dearly in it as a lesson of yours (marked ‹auto›). About US$ 0.045 per chat on average, from your plan. Off: nothing runs.

pasta_meu.title: Folder for your own lessons
pasta_meu.description: Where your lessons live (LICOES-PROPRIAS.md). Empty = ~/.claude/licoes/meu. On 2 computers? Point it at a OneDrive or Dropbox folder.

corrections.title: Learn rules from your corrections
corrections.description: When you correct Claude, a Haiku check spots the rule and shows it above the prompt; one press saves it to CLAUDE.md, in the language you wrote it in. It reads each short message you send: US$ 0.04 per 78 messages measured, about US$ 0.0005 each, from your plan. On by default; turn it off and nothing runs.
